verseText: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
meaning: God commands us to love him completely, giving every part of ourselves to him.

recall.question: What does this verse say we should love God with?

meaning.question: Your heart and soul describe who you are deep inside. What does it mean to love God with all your heart, soul, and strength?
choices: To love Him with all we are
To love Him only with words

application.prompt: God is our Maker and King. We wouldn't be here without him. Because of that, it's our job to live our lives completely for him. Think about one way you could show your love for God today, even when nobody else is watching.
